title: An Act Regarding Health Care
committee_name: Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to amend provisions of law related to health care.

chamber_actions.action: Received by the Clerk of the House on February 20, 2025.
The Bill was REFERRED to the Committee on HEALTH COVERAGE, INSURANCE AND FINANCIAL SERVICES pursuant to Joint Rule 308.2 and ordered printed pursuant to Joint Rule 401.
Carried over, in the same posture, to the next special or regular session of the 132nd Legislature, pursuant to Joint Order SP 519.
Carried over, in the same posture, to any special or regular session of the 132nd Legislature, pursuant to Joint Order SP 800.
